entity.summary: Thailand-licensed centralized digital-asset exchange founded as Satang Corporation in March 2017, acquired by a KasikornBank subsidiary in October 2023, and continued under the Orbix brand.
entity.notes: HEI treats Satang Pro and Orbix as one continuing exchange entity rather than separate predecessor and successor records. The first-party company history places Satang Corporation's founding in March 2017 and the acquisition by Unita Capital, a KasikornBank subsidiary, in October 2023. Current terms identify Orbix Trade Company Limited under Thai law, and current independent exchange data reports active markets. The exact founding day is not stated, so March 1 is used as a month-level marker.

evidence.title: Orbix company profile and history
evidence.notes: First-party company history identifies Orbix Trade Co., Ltd., records the March 2017 founding of Satang Corporation, and records the October 2023 acquisition by Unita Capital, a KasikornBank subsidiary.

evidence.title: Orbix exchange profile and current markets
evidence.notes: Current independent exchange profile identifies Orbix as a Thailand-registered centralized exchange established in 2017, preserves the Satang Pro acquisition and rebrand lineage, and reports current trading markets and activity.
